auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {n} characters long.

vocab.emptyText: Create a list and add words – from a file (CSV, Excel, Quizlet, Anki) or copied straight from Excel.
vocab.unknownLanguage: For spoken answers, enter the language as a name (e.g. «French»), otherwise speech recognition has to guess: {names}
vocab.dropTitle: Create the word list from a file
vocab.dropText: Drag a file here or click · CSV, Excel (.xlsx), Quizlet or Anki export
vocab.tableHelp: Verbs across the top, pronouns on the left, the forms in the cells. You can paste a whole table from Excel (first row = verbs, first column = pronouns). Every cell becomes an entry such as «nous (aller) → allons» and works in all games – Battleship turns it into the game board.
vocab.pasteHelp: Copy two columns from Excel, Google Sheets or Word and paste them here. You can also paste straight into the table below.
vocab.needTitle: Please give the word list a title.
vocab.incompleteRows: Some rows are incomplete. Please fill in both columns or delete the row.

import.checkColumns: Check which columns will be used. Highlighted:
import.willImport: {n} entry will be added | {n} entries will be added
import.skipIncomplete: {n} incomplete row skipped | {n} incomplete rows skipped
import.skipDuplicates: {n} duplicate row skipped | {n} duplicate rows skipped
import.truncated: The file has more than {n} rows – only the first ones are used.

errors.tooLarge: The file is too large (at most {mb} MB).
errors.wordPdf: Word and PDF files can't be read. Copy the table and paste it, or save it as .csv.
errors.unsupported: This format can't be read. Please save it as .xlsx or .csv in Excel/Calc.
errors.excel: The Excel file couldn't be read.
errors.notATable: The file doesn't look like a conjugation table (first row verbs, first column pronouns).

import.rolesHelp: Choose above each column what it contains. Extra columns (e.g. Unit, Page) are saved too – so you can choose words by unit in activities.

activity.emptyText: An activity combines word lists with games and gets a link and QR code for the class.
activity.noSets: You don't have any word lists yet.
activity.gameLanguageHint: Automatic = the language being learned (from the word lists). Applies to all texts in the games.
activity.needsWords: This game needs at least {n} words.
activity.needTitle: Please give the activity a title.
activity.needSet: Please choose at least one word list.
activity.needGame: Please enable at least one game.
activity.filterHelp: Nothing selected = all words. Several values = all of them.
activity.hiddenSets: Plus {n} list only its owner can see. | Plus {n} lists only their owners can see.

play.checkLink: Check the link or ask your teacher.
play.notEnabled: This game isn't enabled in this activity.
play.tooFewWords: Too few words for this game.
play.howToPlay: How do you want to play?
play.singleText: Everyone plays together on one screen.
play.multiText: Everyone plays on their own device – {min} to {max} players.

answer.noSpeechHere: Speaking doesn't work on this device – please type.

speech.micDenied: The microphone isn't allowed. Allow it in the browser settings or choose another answer mode.
speech.nothingHeard: I didn't catch that. Speak a bit louder and try again.
speech.saidQuestionIn: That was «{question}» – say the translation in {language}.
speech.simulated: 🎤 Test mode – what would you have said?
speech.tip: Tip: it works better with an article or pronoun – e.g. «the dog», «vous allez».

note.noService: Speech recognition isn't running on the server – students will only see the other options.
note.simulated: Test mode: speech recognition isn't running, speaking is simulated by typing.
note.https: The microphone needs HTTPS (or localhost) – otherwise speaking is hidden.

game.unavailableText: The room doesn't exist anymore (e.g. because it expired).

room.invite: The others open the link or scan the code on their device.

errors.ALREADY_SHOT: This cell has already been shot at.
errors.CROSS_ORIGIN_REQUEST: The request was rejected for security reasons.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: There's already an account with this email address.
errors.GAME_NOT_ENABLED: This game isn't enabled for the activity.
errors.INVALID_CARD: This card can't be turned over.
errors.INVALID_ROOM_TOKEN: You're not (or no longer) in this room.
errors.NOT_A_MULTIPLAYER_GAME: This game isn't available on several devices.
errors.NOT_ENOUGH_WORDS: The activity has too few words for this game.
errors.NOT_HOST: Only the person who opened the room can do that.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests – wait a moment.
errors.ROOM_NOT_FOUND: This room doesn't exist (anymore). Check the code.
errors.SPEECH_BUSY: Speech recognition is busy right now – try again in a moment.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts – wait a moment.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests – wait a moment.
errors.TOO_MANY_ROOMS: Too many games are open right now. Try again later.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO: The recording has the wrong format.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: There's no teacher account with this email address.

share.title: Share
share.introList: Share this word list with colleagues. They need an account on this platform.
share.introActivity: Share this activity with colleagues. Its word lists are automatically shared with them to view.
share.rightsHelp: View: use and copy. Edit: also change. Only the owner can delete or share further.
share.viewOnly: Shared by {email} – view only. Make a copy to edit it.
share.usedByOthers: Used in {n} activity of another teacher – changes apply there too. | Used in {n} activities of other teachers – changes apply there too.
